svg.title: Completion, commit and retirement are separate
svg.desc: Constructed single-clock times; no measured runtime or delivery guarantee
svg.text: Completion, commit and retirement are separate
Constructed single-clock times; no measured runtime or delivery guarantee
Required handoff, microseconds
Producer ready 8 → sampler finishes 13
ID transfer finishes 15 → commit 18
Sampler span 5 µs; completed commit 18 µs
One logical sampling decision
u = 1/4 selects ID 9 under strict CDF
Retry same u; append / advance once
Cancellation is not a device fence
Admission closes 9; cancellation at 10
Sampler done 13; binding detached 14
Transfer 15; last host reader releases 18
Safe retirement at 18, not earlier
No admission / no binding / no live users
Unknown completion retains its claim
Delivery failure does not rewind committed ID
Norm failure inside a forward differs from selection failure after the forward committed.
Internal one-time append does not establish exactly-once network delivery.
